a.text: Meet the Press debuted with its debut episode.

b.text: General Foods began to air the show on the NBC television network with the title shortened to simply Meet the Press.

a.text: Production moved to NBC's bureau on Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C.

b.text: In January 2021, production of the program moved from WRC-TV facilities in Tenleytown to a ground floor studio in NBCs new Washington D.C. bureau on Capitol Hill.

a.text: Chuck Todd became the show's moderator.

b.text: Rumors surfaced that Gregory would be replaced as the program's moderator.

a.text: The television rights to the program were purchased by General Foods.

b.text: General Foods began to air the show on the NBC television network with the title shortened to simply Meet the Press.

a.text: Tom Brokaw hosted a special edition of Meet the Press dedicated to the life of Russert.

b.text: Brian Williams acted as moderator of the first show following the tribute to Russert.

a.text: Tom Brokaw was named the interim moderator through the 2008 general elections.

b.text: David Gregory began his tenure as moderator.
